spec.couple.cosim.parts: the engine graph@1 of the part g cannot be stepped in time (a co-simulation needs agents@1, circuit-mna@1, clinic@1, des@1, field@1, genetics@1, med@1, ode@1, pid@1, thermal@1, twin@1); couple it in a chain or a loop
spec.couple.cosim: (tEnd − t0) / dt is more than 5000 macro steps
spec.couple.cosim.dt is required (the macro step: how often the parts exchange their values)
